entrypoints.summary: The public GET /cat handler obtains category from the HTTP query parameters.

affected_components.role: Accepts category, constructs the path, reads the resolved file, and serializes a selected line.
Defines the application directory and placement of the names directory and flag fixture.

code_slices.surrounding_context: The callback returns a JSON object containing one line from the file; Dockerfile sets /app as working directory and copies both names and flag.txt there.
code_slices.vulnerable: The /cat callback checks category.length == 1, then resolves './names/' + category and calls fs.readFileSync on the result.

negative_controls: A scalar category with length other than one reaches the 500 error response.
No supplied artifact records an exploit request or successful response.
observability.positive_marker: A response name field containing a line from the selected file.

preconditions: The service must use a query parsing behavior that permits a request-controlled non-scalar category value satisfying the length-one branch.
The resulting string conversion and resolution must select a readable target outside the intended names directory.

capabilities.concept: synchronous read of resolved filesystem path

impacts.concept: HTTP response disclosure of readable file content

mitigations.concept: scalar filename allowlist with resolved-path containment verification

relation_candidates.rationale: The /cat handler incorporates category into the path expression after only a length check.

relation_candidates.dst: synchronous read of resolved filesystem path
relation_candidates.rationale: The resolved path is passed directly to fs.readFileSync.

relation_candidates.dst: HTTP response disclosure of readable file content
relation_candidates.rationale: The read text is split and a selected line is sent as a JSON name response.
relation_candidates.src: synchronous read of resolved filesystem path

relation_candidates.dst: scalar filename allowlist with resolved-path containment verification
relation_candidates.rationale: This inferred mitigation would restrict category to safe scalar names and reject a resolved target outside names before reading.

impact.affected_asset: Files readable by the Node process, including the challenge's /app/flag.txt fixture if the resolved path can reach it.
impact.attacker_capability: An HTTP client that can cause the deployed query parser to supply an accepted non-scalar category representation may influence the path read after JavaScript string conversion.
impact.security_effect: Conditional disclosure of filesystem content through the /cat JSON response.

causal_trace.summary: The GET /cat handler accepts the request-controlled category query value.
The handler admits any category whose .length equals one, but does not establish that category is a scalar safe filename or that its later string conversion denotes one entry below names.
The admitted value is concatenated with ./names/, resolved to a filesystem path, and synchronously read with fs.readFileSync.
Read content is split into lines and one selected line is returned in the JSON name field; the runtime places flag.txt at /app while names is copied under /app/names.

failure.operation: path.resolve of a request-derived concatenation followed by fs.readFileSync

primary_invariant.kind: filesystem path confinement and scalar filename validation
primary_invariant.statement: A category accepted for name lookup must be a scalar allowlisted filename whose resolved target remains beneath the intended names directory.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The code checks only category.length == 1 before concatenation and path resolution; it neither validates the value's type and filename syntax nor verifies containment after resolution.

quality.review_notes: Primary application and runtime artifacts establish the request-to-resolve-to-read flow and flag placement. No supplied request/response trace, lockfile, or parser configuration establishes an exact query encoding that produces a length-one non-scalar value in the deployed Express configuration; therefore exploitability and disclosure are conditional. No remediation patch or executed test is supplied.

remediation.invariant_restored: Only validated scalar category names are mapped to files, and the canonical resolved target is confirmed to be within the names directory before any read.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: No server-side authentication or prior state is shown. The unverified prerequisite is a query-parser-produced category value whose checked length differs materially from its concatenated string form.
data_structure_invariants: category must represent one permitted entry in names.
The resolved read target must remain under the names directory.
state_context.state_machine: A request is rejected unless category.length equals one; accepted input is converted through concatenation, resolved, read, and transformed into a JSON response.
